tender.title: Energy & Net Zero Professional Services Framework
tender.description:
The Energy and Net Zero Professional Services (ENZPS) Framework is a multi-lot Framework Agreement available for the use of the Department for Energy Security and Net Zero (DESNZ) and its Partner Organisations (POs).

The framework consists of 7 lots:

Lot 1 Nuclear
Lot 2 Renewables and Infrastructure
Lot 3 Hydrogen for Heating
Lot 4 Heat Networks
Lot 5 Oil, Gas and Electricity
Lot 6 Emerging Technologies - including Net Zero Innovation
Lot 7 Industrial Transformation

The framework will be for 24 months with an option to extend for 2 further periods of 12 months.

The framework competition was run using the open procedure under PCR2015.
